source_prior_policy: EPA hourly fossil gross output with explicit net conversion or system-fuel reconciliation; NRC daily nuclear status; EIA monthly hydro; stated renewable capacity shares; no internal interface observations
original_12_hour_use: Historical and revisited diagnostic comparison; prior interface errors motivated this independent-data method
validation_selection: Calendar-selected quarter/month-day and time-of-day variety; no interface values consulted for selection. Exact-time absence must be reported, not silently replaced.
new_validation_target_access: Extract and score internal-interface observations only after source-to-zone rules, solver objective and any fitting coefficients are frozen
reporting: Distinguish observed source coverage, estimated zonal generation, plant identity assumptions, fleet capacity limits, and interface prediction; no inferred zonal estimate is relabeled observed telemetry
